name: KLA
description: KLA makes the machines that inspect wafers and masks for defects and measure the tiny structures on them, so chip makers can find problems and raise yields. It sells these to chip makers, with a smaller specialty chip-tool line and a printed-circuit-board and advanced-packaging inspection line. About 23% of revenue is services on machines already installed. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company was above 10% of revenue in each of FY2024, FY2025 and FY2026. China was 29.8% of FY2026 revenue. KLA did a 10-for-1 stock split on 2026-06-11.

businessLines.name: Semiconductor Process Control
businessLines.how: Sale of each inspection or metrology tool to a chip maker, plus service contracts and spares on installed tools (Services 23% of total revenue).
businessLines.description: Inspection, metrology and data analytics products plus related services (wafer inspection, patterning, services).

operatingProfit.note: Segment profit (before interest, other income, restructuring, FX and corporate expenses)

businessLines.name: Specialty Semiconductor Process
businessLines.how: One-time tool sales to specialty (non-leading-edge) chip makers.
businessLines.description: Vacuum deposition and etch tools for specialty semiconductor customers.

businessLines.name: PCB and Component Inspection
businessLines.how: Inspection and related tools sold to PCB, substrate and packaging makers.
businessLines.description: Inspection for printed circuit boards, IC substrates and packaging.
